```
anika: Heads up — deploybot attempted to unpin runtime-3.2 in eu-west canary but hit a sticky hold. Seeing 502s from the canary pool. Can someone triage compatibility with sdk v1.9?

deploybot: SYSTEM: Unpin blocked by pinlist rule 'sticky-pin-detected'.
```
unpin_request: runtime-3.2
region: eu-west
status: blocked
reason: sticky-pin-detected (existing fallback dependency)
id: db-331121
```

sasha: I pulled traces — a bunch of KV cache misses and a kernel fallback loop. Looks like quant kernels in 3.2 + sdk v1.9 path hits a regression under long-seq loads.

mike: If unpin is blocked we should rollback the runtime rollout in eu-west canary to runtime-3.1 to stabilize. Propose 10m rollback window. @eng-runtime pls ack.

ops_bot: Runbook note:
1) set route override -> runtime-3.1 for canary cohort
2) drain new pods
3) monitor keys: /svc/runtime/canary/* for 5m
4) escalate if errors > 1%

elia: ack. We'll prepare the rollback and update release notes. If deploybot still blocks unpin after 3m, execute rollback.

anika: Action items: @mike to trigger rollback, @sasha to verify SDK fallback tests, @deploybot to hold further unpin attempts. I'll post status updates every 2m.

mike: :thumbsup: initiating rollback now. deploybot, execute rollback id rb-331121.

deploybot: ACTION: Rollback initiated by mike.
```
rollback_id: rb-331121
target_runtime: runtime-3.1
region: eu-west
hosts: 24
eta_seconds: ~360
status: in_progress
```

sasha: Logs show traffic shift starting — a short latency spike but KV warmup happening. No new 502s after the first switch.

ops_bot: Warning: expect latency increase up to 600ms during warmup. Threshold set at 500ms; alerting channel if exceeded for >2m.

anika: Noted — we'll watch traces. Postmortem item: add explicit compatibility test between runtime-3.2 (quant kernels) and sdk v1.9 to canary suite; also include a sticky-pin detection step in preflight.

mike: I'll draft the rollback note and pinlist exception entry (reason: kernel/quant mismatch). Planning to revert rollout and block auto-unpin until CI test added.

deploybot: COMPLETED: rollback rb-331121 finished. All canary instances in eu-west on runtime-3.1. No remaining blocked unpins. status: success.

anika: Thanks all — closing thread once release notes + test PRs are up. Filing follow-up ticket: ENG-compat-331121 for the CI test and pinlist policy update.
```
